high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a research article from the journal "IET Smart Cities," published by Wiley. The article is titled "Quick UDP Internet Connections (QUIC) and Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) in unsafe networks: A comparative analysis." It is an original research paper authored by Andrew Simpson, Maitha Alshaali, Wanqing Tu, and Muhammad Rizwan Asghar. Header Information: The article was received on 12 February 2024.
